title: Etch and Copy
description: Make copies of your favorite Etched music discs!
body:
Requires [Etched](https://www.modrinth.com/mod/etched)

***

You know how you can clone a written book? Did you ever want to have a second copy of your favorite music disc?

Well yeah that's why this mod exists

Craft an Etched (or any) music disc with a blank music disc and voila, you now have two of that disc

![A crafting recipe showing the cloning of the Precipice music disc](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/332e19cdc741b663d1008419eb3762bb2cdb4acb.png)
